newsitem.title: FRANCE: AlliedSignal unit announces $543 mln in deals.
newsitem.headline: AlliedSignal unit announces $543 mln in deals.

text.p: Alliedsignal's AlliedSignal Aerospace unit said on Monday it has booked $543 million in new business at the Paris airshow.

The new contracts cover a number of aerospace products and services including a $175 million production contract for AlliedSignal's F124 turbofan engine to power Aero Vodochody's L-159 trainer aircraft for the Czech air force.
Other contracts announced at the airshow were:
* $130 million in avionics and brakes business with a number of German, Russian and Turkish airlines.
* $100 million for LHTEC, an AlliedSignal joint venture for propulsion engine systems for the Ayres Loadmaster utility aircraft.
* $88 million in auxiliary power unit contracts for Airbus aircraft operators worldwide.
* $50 million in new APU for Sikorsky's new S-92 medium lift helicocpter.
